Dombe Wari SEA NOKGIPANI KATTA Dombe Rani-ni bidingo A-chikrangni aganritingbaania ritcha bilsirang ong angpilaha. Da-alona kingkingba Dombe Rani-ni bidingo agane roaniko knana man'eng- pitti. Dombe Rani-ni bidingo angni kn^iminrangoniko, aro mongsongbate angni boningtang Joren Ch. Marakni agananio pangchake anga ia ki-tapko seaha. Dombe Rani-ni bidingo dingtang dingtang agananirang gnang, indiba kattani ma bi-dingde apsan apsan ong tokaia. A chik Katta agananio, Dombe Rani-ni maa paa banoni re-baaha aro bano songdong a-chabaachim, uni am bi atchurang sawarang manchachim uarangko name aro rongtale aganna man-gipa darangba dongjajok. Ma-ambi ma-bidingko aganritinge on-anirango pangchakesa anga iano Dombe Rani-ni gimin seaha. Anga ru-utbea bilsirangonin Dombe Rani-ni bidingo sandibaaha. Indake angni boningtang Joren Ch. Marak an-tangni mamatang atchutang- rangni agananiko knatime man-rikgiminoniko angna aganskae on-aha. Joren Ch. Marakni aganani gitade, Damal Nokat songni mande gitcham Dobu Mankin Sangma aro Dagal-Gopgre songni Sangga Ekupa-mangsa Dombe Rani-ni bidingo an tangtangni jonga-gri, dido dalingrangna agane

donangaha ine agana. Chengonin A chik A-songo mingsing minggamgipa pagitcham ma-gitchamrang dongachim. Indiba uamangni bidingo singsandianirang aro serikanirang dongjaenga ine nikna man-a. Uandakgipa ma-gitcham pagitchamrangni bidingo an-ching agane golpoesan dongkuenga. Indiba bilsi 20 ba 30ni ja-manon agane ongiparangba dongawaha. Uni giminsa anga Dombe Rani-ni bidingo serike donna nangnikaha. lako see rakkianichi chasong gital dido dalingrangba, chengo ambi atchuni chasongode Dombe Rani ingipako chini bugarik pante sekange kima dongana ine knaan baksa, ia segimin ki-tapko poraie u-ie dongpana man-gen ingipa miksonganio anga seaha. Dombe Rani-ni bidingo seaniko saoba mikkangchi namdapatna angko dakchakpaode ua mandeko anga mittelbegen. A-chik ma-gitcham pagitchamrangni Katta an-ching sakantio tangkamchina. Ku-rangchi indake agane riping- baenggipa golporanga knae rona suk onggipa aro su-ugipa kattarang ong-a. Indiba ia chasongo uarang gimaroroangengaha. Uarangko

aganna man gipa aro changgipa manderangba da o dongangtok- jaengjok. Pa Awensing S. Rongmuthu A-chik a-songni salgipeng jolo aganritingbagipa mingsinggipa golpo, Dombe Ranini bidingo adita bilsirangna sandie ia ki-tapo nambee seaha. Uni indake gisik nangbee aro neng-bee kam ka-e ia ki-tapko ong-atna man-ania uni mingsa gamchatbegipa aro namgipa kam ong-chongmota. A-chik ku-sikchi sea-jotanio nambatroroani bidingoba ia ki-tap seani mingsa nambegipa kam ong-a. Dated Tura, the January 18, 2007 Llewellyn. R. Marak Tura DOMBERANI 1 DOMBE RANI A'chikrangni songdongchenggipa songrang Achikrang chengode Tibet asongosa songdong a-chaachim ine agana. Achikrang badiaba chasongo Tibet a-songoni re-ongkatbae Assam-ni a kaweona sokbaaha ina. Uamang a ni brigija, chini ronggakgija, gongma dii-dilma, re-ruma j il-jilma dakako nikbachenggipa Noro Mande Dima Resi ine an-tangtangko u-ijachim ina. Unomiting Assam-ko rajachi sason ka-engachim. Assam-ona sokbaani somoio Dorokma Masema-o demechik sakgittam dongachim. Uamangara Tere, Mere,

aro Dimre ong achim. Uamang Assam rajani sason ka-aniko chakna dongna man-jae, terik mringsniko chap kae Songdu chibimako ga-bat chobatbajokna. Unon Dimre aro Token jiksesa Balsri Sanka biapo songdong a-chaachim ine agana. Uamango Tekme aro Mali minggipa demechik sakgni dongachim. Uamangna chawari sing e sane on-jok; Tekme-na Muni Do-kapa ba Do sing Pante aro Mali-na Aning Sanepa ba Toba Pante. Uamang sadusasa Balsri Sanka songo dongmitingo, a-dok chigaan namja, sigrim bon-grimaia ine salaram mikgitchakchipak re-mikkangbae matchadu-matchabetni songdongramo songdong a-chabajok ina. Indake uamang re-roro katrorobae Samen Sampattal minggipa biapo songdong a-chae jelbra jelsubaaha. Da-o uamangni de-su-drangsa Garo Hills-ni pilak biaprangona piprae songdong a-chatokenga ine pagitchamrang agana. A-chik A-songo songdong- a-chana gado-gakatchenggipa ma-gitcham pagitchamrang chengonin biap damsano songdong a-chabagiparang ong-ja ine chatchi mahari dolantini itihasrango nikna man-a. Uandake chengo gado- gakatchengbaonin biap damsaoni damgipinona jitroroesa songdong a-chabaachim ine agana. Dombe Rani-ni ma’jating ma-ambi Dombe Rani-ni ma-ambi ma-atchurangba Saljagring Rongdigalgalchok songosa songdong a'chabachengaha ine agana. Unonisa katrorobae Warima Cha-samkol songjoini biapdamsao, Chibrasni Wa-gechongsni a-dok chiringrangni jatchio, Manda chibimani braram a-kutchoto adita bilsirangna songdong a-chabae, uanoni salaram mikgitchakchina katbae, Bansamni Kodini, Romba Jelwa-o ru-utbea bilsirangna songdong

a-chatokaha. la songrang ba biaprango rodil cha-dilbagiparangan Dombe Rani-ni ambi atchurang ong-achim ine agana. 2 DOMBERANI Unonisa A-chik asongni salgro, salgipeng, salaram, salirampilak biaprangclii songdong a chatokangjok ina. Indake Dombe Rani-ni ma-gipa pagipaba Bangladesh simachipak mikkange rcTorobae, Gasuapara song jolni kosakchi donggipa Damal Nokatgre minggipa chonbegipa songo dikdiksa roba-cha-bajok ine agana. Dombe Rani-ni atchutangko Bangsan Chengdopa, ambitangko Romi Me chik; Dombe Rani-ni pagipako Kambanda aro ma-gipako Silginchi mingachim. Silginchi-o ba rimarang sak 5 dongachim; uamanga Norik, Notik, Tikme, Jangme, Mongre. Dombe Rani-ni segipa Joreng-ni pagipako Sangreng Mitde Mande aro ma-gipako Nongin Mitde Mande mingachim. Joreng-ni gritangko Mireng aro Dombe Rani-ni demechik dejakrako Dimo Rani mingachim. Sembu Nokatgre Damal Nokatgre songoni katbae, Gungre Rongronggre song gita abriko batsotbae, Rompa chibimako ongonbae, Damet chini sambao donggipa Sembu Nokatgre songo songdongjok a-chajok ine agana. Sembu Nokatgre chonbegipa indiba gitchambegipa song damsa ong achim. Uan Rema maharini a kingo ong-achim. Uanon Dombe Rani-ni ma-gipa Silginchi, ua songo dongsogipa manderangko ano-abi chanc minge ropaeming, an-tangni chatchi mahari Chambugong Wa ge-ko gale, Rema mahario chape pil e, Silginchi Rema Marak

ine chatchi de bajok biming mingbajok. Sembu Nokatgre songo songdong a-chamitingode Dombe Rani- ko oko kekuja an-o changkujachim, indiba unomitingon Dombe-ni atchigniko jajumarigchi agansojok, jadorengchi jadinbajok ina. Dombe Rani-ni nitogniko ma*gipana jumangchi agansoa Dombe Rani-ni ma-gipa Silginchi-na demikkang nikgniko jumango agansoa dongachim. “Bangginengrara gildarerara chodobaengjok; an-cheng biginchirara pura ronggindekosa dinengjok; do-ka mirong tapojang dimelgen, a-ni srempu ronggitchak sandigen. Uni gimin, sona rongsa gita kebitbo, so-re kapsa gita jakkepbo” ine Silginchi-na jajumangchi aganjok, jadorengchi jadinjok ina. “Uni gimin, tangbae bilsi soke, bri-rongsike patti-ra-ronpaode, soka mikgitok dongnap atchipaode ia bi-sani bimingko ‘DOMBE RANI’ ine bimingmingbo, OOMBERANI 3 ma chong de bo” ineba ma gipa Silginchi-na mikjumango aganjok, jajufnangch i jadinjok. Sembu Nokatgre songo dongani obostarang Sembu Nokatgre songo kusi ong-e songdong a-chae, jikma jikse ku-mong nangrime dongengon, raomako de-ana okatchalko pawangko olana. Uano nokrik-nokdake, krong bilpak pil-e, bilbang mande dake, Dura-chipak sone done, Songdu-chipak nokgil on e, matchu agrang gate, rang jengkok songe dongara cha-che a-bo kana, am-bol ja-bak Ghana am-pilengjokchim. Indiba uano chengcheng ja-korako, te-brong manopako ge-e bote donga dimrimbaengon salaram mikgitchakchipakni

balmindria gita, wa-japong spoa gita il-ilbajok, kimkimbajok ina. Uko knasoe Kambanda aro Silginchi jiksesaan tuo tunapja, cha-o cha-napja dakpile dongengachim. Indake ong-engani gimin, mai mancha gam-enga moenga salaram mikgitchakchide ine, “Ra, na-a re-ange niesrangboda” ine Silginchi segipana aganaha. Kambanda uni ki-me tu-gipa, kamalsni dokgipa, anggalsni mom-gipa mil-amko ra-e re-ange nion nikebebejok: salaramchi gongsni saliramchi peksni dake chiringo chagipa prapma sanimao ja-sku weng-san dongaigipa ajaju ba matdengdengsa gokgok dandane tusisoengachim. Durama Imbama- chi huro mikking gipok, makkre ki-me changtok bang-ako nike, uarangko chike cha-na gita ua ajajuara Miminram Jasatram a-brichini re-baachim. Cha-e re-angpilrongon ua Miminram Jasatram a-brionade sokanggija ua prapma sanimaosa ma-chakengachim. Uni tusimitingo enggok ra-a aro ku-biba watani balwanan sambao donggipa sam-bolrang mringmring dakpilengachim aro a-dilma mopilengachim. Uko nikeon Kambanda kenjagoke, “Aiao! iara maidakgipa majadakgipa” ine jagok jabrange noktangona katbapilaha. Ajajuni dal-ara nio nidomanpila ina. Ajaju ja-sku weng-sasan ong-ani gimin gipin matburingrang gita ja-arangko dem-e tusina man-pajachim. Indaken ajaju prapma sanimao gokgoke dandane, an-tangkochan-chokesatusiengachim ina. Ajajuni bimangaraja-kimilan brapong, matchok su-o bu-susu; ku-simangan araru. dm kao raksusu; ja-gitteng sua giteng, ja-rareng manggolsil, jakgitok sisasil daka ina. Kilroro mande dimaresikode an-chi gitting ringgenkon, chikimilding cha-genkon ine Kambanda gisiktangochanchiaha. Uni gimin, “An ching una chake donge on-ode, ja-manja-wilode haida ma-kimae chongtasie

OOMBERANI galnaba donga. Unode bimik ja'siba najawa, bi’sa desaba dongjawa, bondikaignok jachotaignok. An-chingde a-dok namana, chiga silana, nokap ki gongna, cha ana man-ana ka-pake ka-oksie roaiode nam- chongmotjawa” ine Kambanda jikgipa Silginchi-na aganaha. “Na-ara maiko chanchia buchuma? Angni chanchia gitade, samsam-bambamon ong ani gimin wala sala re-bae tua simao, roa andilo an-chingkode cha-naba donga” ua agane sing-dapaha. Unon Silginchi segipana indake aganchakaha, “Nang-ni jikgipa ine chano mingode na-a angko jechi jachiba katdile rodile dongdilbojok.” Unon mai cholchi ua ajajuko ma-kimana chong-tasiatna man-gen Kambanda gisiktango chanchie niaha. Indake ua kamalsni dokgipa, turisni mom-gipa atte nokma mongrengko ra bachina gita Me-gam Dokapa Dikii me-apako aganataha. Adita salrangni jamano, Me-gam Dokapa Dikii me-apa atte nokma mongrengko Kambanda-na ra-bae on-aha. Indake Durama Imbama-chi ajajuni reange dearok tangmisilko cha-e ringe romiting chachaosa Kambanda atte nokma mongrengko ra-e ajajuni turonggipa biapona re-angaha. Kambanda prapma sanima- ko paksamsa den-e wang-e don-bajok, jedakode ajajuni gokgok dandane tusimitingo ua be-gropdilgen aro unode ajaju jagok jabrange gipin a-dokchi katanggen. Jensalo sal napangaha unon ajaju Durama Imbama-chi re-ange huro mikking gipok, makkre kime changtokko cha-aoni re-bapile apsan prapma sanimaon gokgoke dandane dongengachim. Unon uni dandanchakgipa prapma sanima rang-san be-gropdilaha. Ajajuni jak

samsako prap cheksisa sinjetdape be-dapaha. Indakesa ua chakatpilna man-jae siaijok aro prapma sanima bol baksan sogrim bon-grimaijokna ina. Ua biapkon da-alonaba Ajaju Chiring ine mingenga. la Ajaju Chiringon banoba banobade ajajuni grengrangko da-onan nikkuenga ine agana, indiba uni bang-bata biaprangkon a-a rudapaha. Jensalo ajaju sijok bon-jok unon, “A-dok chiring marang starang nangjok, a-dok chiga namjajok. lano dongkuode rokuode mangra mangri a-brichi dogen, mima kera olramchi, matchu boldak karamchi re-gen. Unode chiamako ringgnok, chidimakko cha-gnok. Uni gimin an-ching tangbae bilsi soknade gipin a-dok chiringchi kate jite dongna nanggnok” ine uamang jikma jiksean salaram mikgitchakchipak re-e nina ku-mongaha ina. OOMBERANI 5 Aruak Pattal Na*gilnia Jenggal-ona katbaa Indake uamang salaram mikgitchakchi mikkange re angroroe nion pattalarigipa, rongbrakraragipa biapona sokeaha. Uano chiga chiring nama, kasi mikgil te-tiba chaa, rongma chisam sambikba dika, na-bat batrorimaba jela, en tik kolorimaba bang-a ine nikeming, Bibragre songni salgipengchipak, Gamegajing okgripo, Aruak Pattal Na gilma Jenggal-o songdongtainaa-chataina namnikjok ina. ‘Aiao! chel-achiba re jajok jitjajok; a song chuarakoba, a king gildarongoba, gongma reruma dikoba, darang asong chigako nikgam nigamjaoba, jongska adatang noska abitang dongjaoba ianon dongai- gnok. Matcha elbikbikoba rike galbo, balwa balbimaoba nape chakbo’

ine songdong a-chana kusi ong-e Aruak Pattal Na gilma Jenggal-on songdong a chaeaha ine agana. Dao uamang jikmajikse kumonge, darangba ua biapko samsep bolsepadongja ine nike, raiot-jangkeo, nokma sanio singgija amgijan, darangba rikgaljawa sanaljawa ine chanchie dongaijok roaijok ina; maina skangni manderangde nokapna ki gongna a kangode samsepe bolsepe donrongachim. Ua biapara Bibragre, Renegre, Rampagre aro Kingkanggre songbrinisima arigriko onga. Aruak Pattal Na’gilma Jenggal-o ma-chakna nok rika Kambanda ma-chakna ine nok rikon, salaramchi nokmikkang, saliramchi nokkisang, salgipengchi kompa dun ragipa, aro salgrochipak ‘nokmea’ donaha. Nokmeara sa-ra rogipa kilboragipa soko nao, wakrampak dorampakna re o, tangka paisako srona re o, a-jak duna re-o asongchakram biap. Uanon am pok ja groko donronga. Ukon ‘Nokmea’ ba ‘Nokrama’ ine agana. Nokmeasan ong-aija, nokni bako ‘nokmechik’ ingipa biapba donga. Nokmechiko nokni ma gipa aro demechikrangna agre, wano ringo aro krit-amuoba me asarang asongna ropana niam dongja; maina ua biapara mi bijak song chak- ramsa ong a. Uano chachawari dinok pantede asongna kraja nitoja - doka mandal ringa gita, matchu noko gaa gita nikaia ina. Indake Kambanda Dareng chibimani rikamo, Aruak Pattal Na gilma Jenggal-o nokrik nokdake rojok dongjok ine agana. 6 DOMBERANI Soka mikgitok soka

Sembu Nokatgre songo dongmitingonin jajumang sienggipa, jadorengchi jadinenggipa da onaba apsan daken ong kuaengachim. Indakgipa jumangrangko nike, Silginchi gisiktango jajrengbee, maiko indake jumang siengjok jaring japakengjok ine aiao inmanengachim; maina uamang j ikmaj ikseni jumang nikara salsa ongja saigni ong-ja, walsa ongja walgni ongja; uamang Dombe Rani-ko jako mankujana kingking indake jumang niksimsimaiachim ina. Indibaadita sal jarangna Aruak Pattal Na-gilma Jenggal-o dongangkuon indita bilsirangna skangonin indake jajumang sicnggipajadorengchi jadinenggipa been pilnagita da o sal ong bebeengjok ine Silginchi u ibaaha. Indake uamangjiksesa kusi onge turam tue dongeng-chaengmitingon Silginchi jaojribajok, oko chidongbajok. Deawa depakmana salde jade sokengjok ine Silginchi an tangan u ibaaha. Indaken ua ka asuangka suang, ka asirok ka sirok, basakobade mikchiritak teritak dake chanchibee dongengon, jedakeba uni olbit-kebitenggipade me chik ong chongmotgen ine an tangan u isoaha ina. Je a sel ong oba segipa Kambanda uko jakgualjachim. Silginchi-ni dingtangengako nike segipa sing aha, ‘'Maia ong-enga na ara; an tangan saengama?’' "‘Oe, angni saade dingtangjok, soka mikgitokan dendenaengjok naa!” Silginchi aganchakjok. DOMBERANI 7 I nie dongtokaijok ina. Dombe Rani awadek ong engon bolchu bibal balgala gita, mandal bibal chong gala gita dakaiachim ina. Unaanba, “Nang ni oko kegipa an o changgipakode Dakgipaan Rugipaan dingtangmancha ba nangatjok chinangatjok. Uni gimin, jako ra e chelo kae miktuatgija taptugija name mittangbo aldubojok” ine kamalba kuraronjok ina. Dombe Rani salsarikrik batrikrik, walsarikrik dal rikrik dakbaenba ja del bilsokna a bachengbaon chae ku dimna gitik, rim e chikbakna gitik dake kadangpila ina. Kni rikge rikgeo sona bibal balana, jaksi ku'terikingo tangkamiksil su ana; be en chongra kimjimjim.

rasin jaksila, kuchil mandal bibalan bibal, wagam kitma bitchilan biu Toa nongna nanggijan kni chijimaiana, gue cha na nanggijan ku cliil gitchakaiana; mikkang gangma naako nioba nikjana, been anripuako am oba man jana. Chisam kapo polia salna rongdimelpitti, a ningoni rongsare aandimu nangpitti, narang mina tapojang ontisade dimela, aski tanorikoba aram mittin simdapa; indiba Dombe-ni bimang angilde mamingdimelanian dongjachim. Be en chongra kimjimjim, chelabaku tim-motmot, ja ping me a ogala gita, sokme mona rachi gita dake nomil bilsokbajok, pante bisring kabajok. Dombe Rani-ara indakpile nitoana daknangana da nang. Dombe Rani an tangni ma a paa, chame apa aro pilak ripcng- skarang baksa ku rang salo knatoe, katta wato rinoke, gisik bewal dimbrengejakkipmeranggnange rorongachim kal rongachim ina. Uni giminsa manderang ‘Buga Mikdep’ ine aganronga. Dombe Rani-ko man*pila Jorengjikgipa Dombe Rani-ko man-pile kusi ong-beaha. Uamangjikma Jikse songo noko apsan ropiljok dongpiljok. Indiba ja-manja-wilo maiba a-sel ong-genma ine Joreng gisiko chanchie, kena gnangsa dongengachim ina. Uni ja-mano Renegre songo donggipa mamatang Dichang Bodorka re-bae uamangna indake aganaha, “Nasong ia apsan biapon songdong a-chakuode, haida chengo gita mini gita, chio chikimitna songko songgimanasa jumang sitainaba, jadoreng pil-tainaba gnang. Uni gimin, gipin biapko a-dok chigako nokap ki-gongna sandibojok bi-ambojok.” Indake ong-engon, bugarik pante Joreng-ko ka-onangbee, ‘Bani a-ningo chaksogen, bani chigao rosogen; a-ning mitap chi-gni, chining

dm chi-gni konge biteja-san ja-wile nigen, watchongmotjawa’ ine walsa changgija salsa dongija jumang sitaijokna, jadorengchi Jadintaiana. Indake uamang Amak Te-bilgong Na-gilma Jenggal songoni. 18 DOMBERANI ATtiisrom gita, Kakija chibimako batsote, gongma re-ruma, troptna jil-jilma gita, KilbolmaNonagi, A’sak Durangre gita, wala walsni sala salsni re'ange katange, Miminram a-brini ja-pao, Eman Baljam a'kingni jatchio, diltubegipa buring a-juai, bolkusimang chagipa, wama kongsi nanggipa, mongma-matcha dongram biapo, dal-begipa bol prapma sanimao madane gokgoke donggnok chakgnok ine, jangke tek kolatchi tekdoe, prapma sanimani kosako nok rikaha ina. Unon Joreng, “Ani prem jimjemba, chini buga, ani matchaba re bae nibo, dake nibo” ine ra bie-ra tinge adita ja rang rodiljok

dongdiljok ina. Uni gimin, angko jeba dakchina, naade nonomangko rime gipin biap a-damo dongdilbo rodilbojok, ong-jaode an-chingde ma-kimaaignok chong-tasiaignok.” Uchi Joreng-ba inskaaiana da-nang, “Darangchiba jitjawa, gipinchiba katjawa. Da-omancha re-bataie dakbebea ong-ode, a-nima ginde cha-pile, chigilbo chima tippile dakgrik dinggrike niaigen; nang-ko bano donanggen, nang-ko bano taptugen.” Bugarik pante Dombe-ko sandianga Beanbebe, bugarik pante a-ning mitapchi-gni, chining druchi-gni napange sandiangjok, nigamangjok ina. Unon wala walsni sala salsni ong-jokna. Unon bugarik pante ‘bano nape chaksogen, baona kate dong- DOMBERANi 19

sogen’ ine ka ko doke ka-kimchae, a-nimako napangtaijok, chinimako bitangtaijok ina. Indake bugarik Eman Baljam-o Dombe-mangni ma-chakgipa ma-dangipa prapma sanimaona sokangon waimako waate, ditemako dilate, walsni salsni kongjok tinjok ine agana. Unon a-nima bikbo bikbo, chinima jiljo jiljo dakbae wal-nima andaljokna,salnimakimitjoknada-nang! Rapruangjok! a-chatokaha. la songrang ba biaprango rodil cha-dilbagiparangan Dombe Rani-ni ambi atchurang ong-achim ine agana. 2 DOMBERANI Unonisa A-chik asongni salgro, salgipeng, salaram, salirampilak biaprangclii songdong a chatokangjok ina. ine chatchi de bajok biming mingbajok. Dombe Rani-ni nitogniko ma*gipana jumangchi agansoa Dombe Rani-ni ma-gipa Silginchi-na demikkang nikgniko jumango agansoa dongachim. “Bangginengrara gildarerara chodobaengjok; an-cheng biginchirara pura ronggindekosa dinengjok; do-ka mirong tapojang dimelgen, a-ni srempu ronggitchak sandigen. Sembu Nokatgre songo dongani obostarang Sembu Nokatgre songo kusi ong-e songdong a-chae, jikma jikse ku-mong nangrime dongengon, raomako de-ana okatchalko pawangko olana. Uano nokrik-nokdake, krong bilpak pil-e, bilbang mande dake, Dura-chipak sone done, Songdu-chipak nokgil on e, matchu agrang gate, rang jengkok songe dongara cha-che a-bo kana, am-bol ja-bak Ghana am-pilengjokchim. Indiba uano chengcheng ja-korako, te-brong manopako ge-e bote donga dimrimbaengon salaram mikgitchakchipakni

balmindria gita, wa-japong spoa gita il-ilbajok, kimkimbajok ina. Uko knasoe Kambanda aro Silginchi jiksesaan tuo tunapja, cha-o cha-napja dakpile dongengachim. Indake ong-engani gimin, mai mancha gam-enga moenga salaram mikgitchakchide ine, “Ra, na-a re-ange niesrangboda” ine Silginchi segipana aganaha. Kambanda uni ki-me tu-gipa, kamalsni dokgipa, anggalsni mom-gipa mil-amko ra-e re-ange nion nikebebejok: salaramchi gongsni saliramchi peksni dake chiringo chagipa prapma sanimao ja-sku weng-san dongaigipa ajaju ba matdengdengsa gokgok dandane tusisoengachim. Durama Imbama- chi huro mikking gipok, makkre ki-me changtok bang-ako nike, uarangko chike cha-na gita ua ajajuara Miminram Jasatram a-brichini re-baachim. Cha-e re-angpilrongon ua Miminram Jasatram a-brionade sokanggija ua prapma sanimaosa ma-chakengachim. Uni tusimitingo enggok ra-a aro ku-biba watani balwanan sambao donggipa sam-bolrang mringmring dakpilengachim aro a-dilma mopilengachim. Uko nikeon Kambanda kenjagoke, “Aiao! iara maidakgipa majadakgipa” ine jagok jabrange noktangona katbapilaha. Ajajuni dal-ara nio nidomanpila ina. Ajaju ja-sku weng-sasan ong-ani gimin gipin matburingrang gita ja-arangko dem-e tusina man-pajachim. Indaken ajaju prapma sanimao gokgoke dandane, an-tangkochan-chokesatusiengachim ina. Ajajuni bimangaraja-kimilan brapong, matchok su-o bu-susu; ku-simangan araru. dm kao raksusu; ja-gitteng sua giteng, ja-rareng manggolsil, jakgitok sisasil daka ina. Kilroro mande dimaresikode an-chi gitting ringgenkon, chikimilding cha-genkon ine Kambanda gisiktangochanchiaha. Uni gimin, “An ching una chake donge on-ode, ja-manja-wilode haida ma-kimae chongtasie

OOMBERANI galnaba donga. Unode bimik ja'siba najawa, bi’sa desaba dongjawa, bondikaignok jachotaignok. An-chingde a-dok namana, chiga silana, nokap ki gongna, cha ana man-ana ka-pake ka-oksie roaiode nam- chongmotjawa” ine Kambanda jikgipa Silginchi-na aganaha. “Na-ara maiko chanchia buchuma? Angni chanchia gitade, samsam-bambamon ong ani gimin wala sala re-bae tua simao, roa andilo an-chingkode cha-naba donga” ua agane sing-dapaha. Unon Silginchi segipana indake aganchakaha, “Nang-ni jikgipa ine chano mingode na-a angko jechi jachiba katdile rodile dongdilbojok.” Unon mai cholchi ua ajajuko ma-kimana chong-tasiatna man-gen Kambanda gisiktango chanchie niaha. Indake ua kamalsni dokgipa, turisni mom-gipa atte nokma mongrengko ra bachina gita Me-gam Dokapa Dikii me-apako aganataha. Adita salrangni jamano, Me-gam Dokapa Dikii me-apa atte nokma mongrengko Kambanda-na ra-bae on-aha. Indake Durama Imbama-chi ajajuni reange dearok tangmisilko cha-e ringe romiting chachaosa Kambanda atte nokma mongrengko ra-e ajajuni turonggipa biapona re-angaha. Kambanda prapma sanima- ko paksamsa den-e wang-e don-bajok, jedakode ajajuni gokgok dandane tusimitingo ua be-gropdilgen aro unode ajaju jagok jabrange gipin a-dokchi katanggen. Jensalo sal napangaha unon ajaju Durama Imbama-chi re-ange huro mikking gipok, makkre kime changtokko cha-aoni re-bapile apsan prapma sanimaon gokgoke dandane dongengachim. Unon uni dandanchakgipa prapma sanima rang-san be-gropdilaha. Ajajuni jak

samsako prap cheksisa sinjetdape be-dapaha. Indakesa ua chakatpilna man-jae siaijok aro prapma sanima bol baksan sogrim bon-grimaijokna ina. Ua biapkon da-alonaba Ajaju Chiring ine mingenga. la Ajaju Chiringon banoba banobade ajajuni grengrangko da-onan nikkuenga ine agana, indiba uni bang-bata biaprangkon a-a rudapaha. Jensalo ajaju sijok bon-jok unon, “A-dok chiring marang starang nangjok, a-dok chiga namjajok. lano dongkuode rokuode mangra mangri a-brichi dogen, mima kera olramchi, matchu boldak karamchi re-gen.
